name: Bird Protection
summary: Small annual grants for projects focused on highly threatened or poorly known bird species worldwide. Applications are submitted by email as a single PDF in English or Swedish.

calls.label: Annual applications
calls.recurring: Applications are due by July 31 each year.

status.quote: Applications are accepted on a yearly basis.

recurring.quote: Applications for each year must be received by July 31st.

geography.quote: Since 1991 the Swedish Club300 has contributed more than USD600,000 to bird protection projects all around the world.

access.quote: Applications are only accepted as a single PDF file sent via e-mail to birdprotection@club300.se.

window.quote: Applications are accepted on a yearly basis.

amount.quote: The maximum annual amount granted to a single project is USD 5,000.
